title: Send a raw HTTP GET request using netcat
summary: Use netcat to send a simple HTTP GET request to a web server. This is useful for testing server responses or debugging HTTP headers without a browser.

steps.explain: Construct an HTTP GET request string using echo and pipe it to netcat, which connects to the host on port 80.

placeholders.name: HOST
placeholders.description: The domain name or IP address of the web server
